transfer.status: proposal pending operator approval after Phase04; no final GLB or PlayCanvas implementation
transfer.solar: Same hour/observer/orientation parameters; interpolate sky, exposure and sun; no sensor events from clock
transfer.lights: Area lights in Blender require tested punctual-light equivalents in PlayCanvas; individual mutable emitters remain separate. Compare against approved references before accepting any visual loss.
transfer.baking: Never bake mutable artificial illumination into an immutable room lightmap. Any environment/probe variants must exclude switchable light contribution.
